description: Eight temporal surrogate patterns (T1–T8); deterministic compile/Z3 smoke.

patterns.nl_line: start_x must be strictly before start_y.
Refund may be issued only if identity_verified equals 1.
If step_b_complete equals 1 then step_a_complete must equal 1.
When phase equals 2, review_required must equal 1.
Exactly one of draft_mode, review_mode, published_mode must be true.
At least 2 of income_verified, identity_verified, address_verified, employment_verified must hold.
When workflow_state is pending, approver_assigned must be 1.
retry_count must be between 0 and 5 inclusive.
